title: Business Education Methods
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered good when you provide useful activities that would help the learners to discover facts and contribute effectively to the learning activities."
A teaching method is considered good when you provide useful activities that would help the learners to discover facts and contribute effectively to the learning activities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the compulsory subjects offered by junior secondary school students in Nigeria."
Business Studies is one of the compulsory subjects offered by junior secondary school students in Nigeria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to series of activities geared towards helping students learn."
Teaching refers to series of activities geared towards helping students learn.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to show the students, good sitting position, how to hold the pencil, how to turn over the notebook page, good outline formation, how to build mental storage, etc."
The demonstration method is used to show the students, good sitting position, how to hold the pencil, how to turn over the notebook page, good outline formation, how to build mental storage, etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important aspect of business studies."
Bookkeeping is an important aspect of business studies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with students' potentials for growth and development than with their abilities."
The theory y teacher is concerned with students' potentials for growth and development than with their abilities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method where attention is paid to the individual learner."
The individualised teaching method is a method where attention is paid to the individual learner.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the "Heart" or otherwise the central part of the lesson."
The presentation stage is the "Heart" or otherwise the central part of the lesson.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with skill development, which is developed through the demonstration method."
Demonstration method Typewriting instruction is concerned with skill development, which is developed through the demonstration method.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a powerful tool for motivating learning."
Interest is a powerful tool for motivating learning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a learning process which is constantly applied in business education instruction."
Motivation is a learning process which is constantly applied in business education instruction.
fib: ______ is the formal presentation of subject matter that has been selected on the basis of the educator's idea of its value to the students.
stimulus

facts process approach
The facts process approach is a method generally used for students in higher institutions.

Tolman's theory
Tolman's theory is the reason why good teaching environment is emphasised in the teaching of business studies.

learner-centred method
The learner-centred method is a method whereby students are opportune to participate actively in the teaching-learning process while the teacher plays a more passive role.

Reinforcement
Reinforcement is one of the key principles of learning.

S-R theory
The S-R theory is the basis for the "part method" of presenting subject matter to students.

teacher-centred method

Teaching methods
Teaching methods are the strategies adopted and used by teachers in transferring learning in a classroom teaching-learning process.

Shorthand

Re-enforcement
